about.title: From server to interface, with real engineering.
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Web Developer at Agência Gecko Digital and a Computer Engineer from UNIFEI, with a technical degree in Mechatronics from ETEP.
I architect and maintain digital ecosystems: CMS, server infrastructure, tracking with Google Tag Manager and customer service chatbots.
For my thesis I built an AI health chatbot (RAG + LLM), and I'm currently building an application with Go, PostgreSQL and Docker to deepen my back-end, containerization and data modeling skills.
